verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Memories let ChatGPT carry useful context from earlier chats into future work. Users get documented controls (`/memories`) over whether a chat uses existing memories or contributes to future ones, and Projects add shared context across related chats. The community comment about 'limited memory' describes forgetting within a single conversation, not cross-chat memory, so it does not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: detail on how relevant memories are selected and applied, documented memory review/editing in the main ChatGPT UI, and independent hands-on corroboration of cross-chat recall.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant remember relevant context from previous chats and apply it in new conversations
